mechanism_narrative: Higher levels of non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) indicate a strong labor market, which supports corporate earnings growth and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: The correlation between PAYEMS level and 5-day S&P 500 returns is negative or insignificant (p>0.05) in a rolling 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) above 0.5% per annum signals an imminent monetary tightening cycle, which increases discount rates and reduces equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS has risen above 0.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in CPI (CPIAUCSL) and decline in unemployment rate (UNRATE) signals an overheating economy, prompting the Federal Reserve to tighten monetary policy, which leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal of rising CPIAUCSL and falling UNRATE fails to predict negative returns in > 60% of instances (i.e., returns are positive in > 60% of cases when the condition holds).

mechanism_narrative: During periods of high inflation (CPIAUCSL > 2.5% year-over-year), the Federal Reserve is likely to tighten policy, which increases the risk of equity market corrections, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of instances where CPIAUCSL is above 2.5% year-over-year.

mechanism_narrative: Higher industrial production (INDPRO) indicates strong economic activity, supporting corporate earnings and leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The correlation between INDPRO level and 20-day S&P 500 returns is negative or insignificant (p>0.05) in a rolling 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) fall below 450,000 units, it signals a weakening housing market, which is a leading indicator of economic slowdown, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5-day returns in > 60% of instances where HOUST is below 450.

mechanism_narrative: Higher retail sales (RSAFS) indicate strong consumer demand, which supports corporate earnings and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The correlation between RSAFS level and 60-day S&P 500 returns is negative or insignificant (p>0.05) in a rolling 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: When the consumer price index (CPIAUCSL) rises above 2.5% year-over-year and housing starts (HOUST) fall below 450,000 units, it signals a combination of inflation and weak housing, which increases the risk of recession and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal of CPIAUCSL > 2.5% and HOUST < 450 fails to predict negative returns in > 60% of instances.
